EmailTemplate.name: SAL SLA Expired
EmailTemplate.subject: Please qualify your SAL lead
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Lead.OwnerFirstName},
The lead {!Lead.Name} from {!Lead.Company} owned by you has been in Lead Stage “SAL”, and the Lead Status has not been changed to “Qualified,” “Disqualified,” “Unreachable,” or “Passed to Partner” within the maximum SLA time. Click here to visit this lead record in SFDC
As a reminder, the following SLA’s are expected for any SAL lead: - Initial Task (Email or Phone Call) to be logged within 1 business day of acceptance - Qualification or Rejection via Lead Status to occur within 4 business weeks of acceptance Please disposition the record by reaching out to the lead ASAP and mark with the appropriate Lead Status. Please be sure to log all emails or called. Thank you.
